mappings.rationale: KBLI-2020 code 38220 'Treatment dan Pembuangan Limbah Berbahaya' was a single, broadly-scoped hazardous-waste-disposal code that did not distinguish radioactive from non-radioactive waste streams. BPS Vol.2 crosswalk Lampiran 5 (p.170, forward 2020->2025) shows 38220 explicitly splitting into two adjacent 2025 rows: 38221 'Pengolahan dan Pembuangan Limbah atau Sampah Berbahaya Selain Limbah Radioaktif' and 38222 'Pengolahan dan Pembuangan Limbah Radioaktif'; Lampiran 10 (p.364, reverse 2025->2020) cross-confirms both daughter codes point back to the same 2020 source 38220. This is corroborated at the uraian level by OSS relasi.json's subgolongan-3822 description, which narrates the pre-split activity bundle as containing both a generic B3 stream (explosive/oxidizing/flammable/toxic/irritant/carcinogenic/corrosive/infectious substances) and a distinct radioactive-waste clause ('pengolahan, pembuangan dan penyimpanan limbah radioaktif, termasuk: pengolahan dan pembuangan limbah radioaktif dalam masa transisi, yaitu peluruhan selama periode pengangkutan, dari rumah sakit; enkapsulasi, penyiapan dan treatment lainnya terhadap limbah radioaktif') that became 38222's own uraian verbatim. The distinguishing fact driving the split is the physical/regulatory nature of the waste (radioactive material vs generic B3 material), not a title reword. PP28 Lampiran I.V.33 (p.227), row 4, code 38220 (KBLI-2020 vintage, since PP28 predates the 2025 recode) further shows the single licensing row mixing generic B3-penimbunan kewajiban with radioactive-specific PB UMKU sub-items (Dekomisioning/Konstruksi/Operasi/Pernyataan Pembebasan Fasilitas Pengelolaan Limbah Radioaktif) -- confirming the licensing source itself pre-mixed the two activities that KBLI-2025 later disaggregated into 38221 and 38222.

payload.notes: Crosswalk mapping is unambiguous: 2020-code 38220 SPLIT into 2025-codes 38221 (non-radioactive hazardous waste) and 38222 (radioactive waste), confirmed bidirectionally (Lampiran 5 forward p.170 + Lampiran 10 reverse p.364) and corroborated semantically by OSS relasi.json's subgolongan-3822 uraian, which already narrates the radioactive-vs-generic-B3 distinction pre-split. Not title-similarity-only: the operative fact is the waste's radioactive nature driving separate regulatory oversight, verified by reading the rendered PNG digits directly (38220/38221/38222 clearly distinct in table, no OCR ambiguity risk observed). OSS ruang_lingkup and umku endpoints both confirmed absent (404) via oss/ABSENT.json -- recorded as absent per instructions, not guessed. licensing_inherits=true because canonical.json's per_skala licensing facts (jangka_waktu, kewenangan, persyaratan, kewajiban, pb_umku) derive from the single PP28 Lampiran I.V.33 row for KBLI-2020 code 38220, which is shared with sibling split-code 38221 and mixes generic-B3 with radioactive-specific PB UMKU line items -- D2 image-verified row extraction is needed to keep this correctly scoped to 38222 only (the visible PP28 crop confirms 3 of the 4 pb_umku items; the 4th, 'Pernyataan Pembebasan Fasilitas Pengelolaan Limbah Radioaktif', is present in canonical.json but only partially visible at the crop's bottom edge -- D2 should re-verify against the full multi-page PP28 row before trusting it beyond this D1 pass).

reasons: Independently re-derived the crosswalk from crosswalk/lampiran5_p170-170.png (forward 2020->2025): row 38220 'Treatment dan Pembuangan Limbah Berbahaya' appears twice, split into 38221 (non-radioactive B3) and 38222 (radioactive) -- matches D1's SPLIT claim exactly, not the stale 'CODICE_RINUMERATO' label in canonical.json.

Independently confirmed via crosswalk/lampiran10_p364-364.png (reverse 2025->2020) that both 38221 and 38222 point back to the single 2020 source 38220, with no other 2020 code feeding into 38222 -- bidirectional confirmation matches D1 exactly.

Independently read pp28/394947_p227-227.png row 4 (Kode 38220): Ruang Lingkup 'Penimbunan Limbah B3', Kewajiban column is generic-B3 language matching canonical.json's 10-item kewajiban list, while PB UMKU column lists radioactive-specific facility items (Dekomisioning/Konstruksi/Operasi Fasilitas Pengelolaan Limbah Radioaktif) with the 4th item cut off at the crop edge -- confirms D1's claim of a pre-split mixed licensing row, including D1's honest disclosure of the partially-visible 4th PB UMKU item.
Independently compared oss/relasi.json subgolongan-3822 uraian text against canonical.json's 38222 uraian: near-verbatim match (one trivial synonym swap), confirming D1's corroboration claim.
Independently read oss/ABSENT.json: both ruang_lingkup and umku endpoints recorded as 404/absent, matching D1's notes exactly with no fabrication.

No unsupported claim, misread digit, or phantom citation found anywhere in the proposal; licensing_inherits=true conclusion is well-supported by the shared PP28 source row and appropriately caveated for D2 re-verification.
